name: AUTOPILOT.OI Shop Agent
description_html:
Build a TikTok Shop that makes real profit.

Turn Claude into your TikTok Shop Agent in 10 minutes. Picks products that can win, checks your profit before you list, writes compliant listings, recruits affiliate creators and runs your weekly shop review.

Inside: the full master prompt, 5 starter prompts, a step by step setup and your tracker. Works with Claude's free or paid plan.

Education only. Confirm TikTok's current rules and fees in the app. AUTOPILOT.OI is independent and not affiliated with Anthropic or TikTok.
